title: Reading doesn't delete: every group keeps its own offset
caption: Billing reads the newest record while a brand-new analytics group replays the same partition from the start.

messages.label: append key 17 → offset 3
messages.note: Offsets 0–2 already exist. The new record goes to the tail and gets offset 3 for good.

messages.label: poll from committed offset 3
messages.note: Billing has finished 0–2, so its committed offset is 3: the next one to read.

messages.label: commit offset 4
messages.note: A commit just saves 'done up to here' for this group. The record stays in the log.

messages.label: poll from offset 0 (earliest)
messages.note: A new group, or one rewound after a bug fix, starts wherever it likes inside the retention window.

messages.label: records 0, 1, 2, 3
messages.note: Same records, independent position. Billing isn't affected, and the producer did nothing extra.
